senses.gloss:
(I)--a R. source of, sacred to Hari;
1: भा. VII. १४. २९, VIII. 4. २३, Br. II. १६. ११, २४.
brought to the earth from Heaven; a महानदी from the Himalayas.
2: वा. ४२. ३९-49: ७१. 5.
Originating from the foot of विष्णु and watering the region of the moon falls from heaven into ब्रह्मा's city; issuing from the nail of the great toe of Hari's left foot; Dhruva holds her in his crown; the seven sages perform austerities with her waters; issuing again from the moon she falls on Sumeru and thence to the four quarters of the earth; hearing of her, the desire to go to गन्गा, see, touch, bathe in her waters--all purify a person; falling in four directions, takes the names of शीता, अलकनन्दा, चक्षु and भद्रा.
3: वी. I. 9. १०३: II, 2. ३३४: 8. १०८-13, १२०-2: III. १४. १८ IV. 4. २६-30: १८-28.
Effort made by अम्शुमान्, दिलीप and भगीरथ and hence her name भागीरथी. Held up by Hara and then let; flowed in seven streams through several territories in the four directions, sanctifying the regions and the people there.
4: भा. IX. 9. 1-१३: Br. III. १३. ११८: ५५. ५१: ५६. ३८-54.
Its waters drunk by Janhu, and let out by his ears and hence called जान्हवी.
5: भा. IX. १५. 3: Br. III. ६६. २५-6: ७३. ११७: M. १२. ४४: १२१. २६.
The seed cast off by शिव in the [page१-502+ ४८] sky was borne by गन्गा and was swallowed by Agni; phoetus left on the Himalayan slopes became gold, which was utilised in building the यग्ञशाल at नैमिष. At her confluence with यमुना (s.v.) was the अवभृत of the sacri- fice of प्रजापतिस्. On its banks Bharata performed horse- sacrifice.
6: भा. IV. 7. ६३-4: वा. 2. १७-18: ७२. २८-32. Br. II. १६. ११ and २४. भा. VII. १४. २९; VIII. 4. २३ Va1. ४२. ३९-40: ७१. 5. भा. IX. 9. 1-१३. Br. III. १३. ११८: ५५.51: ५६. ३८-54. M. १५. 3. Br. III. ६६. २५. 6: ७३. ११७: M. १२. ४४: १२१. २६. भा. IV. 7. ६३-64. वा. 2. १७-18: ७२. २८-32. भा. IV. 2. ३५. IX. २०-25: २२. १९: X. १०. 4.
Here युधिष्ठिर had his अवभृत bath after राजसूय.
7: भा. X. ७५. १९.
Here were done funeral rites of the dead children of द्रौपदी.
8: Ib. I. 8. 1.
Here again परीक्षित् observed vow of fasting unto death.
9: Ib. 3. ४३; 4. १०; १२. २८; १८. 3.
Visited by बलराम.
१०: Ib. X. ७८. २०.
The Sagaras sent to heaven by the Ganges waters.
११: Ib. IX. 9. १४.
गन्गा as देवी.
१२: Ib. I. १९. १५.
Originally of three-fold path, the छायापथा being in the नक्षत्रमण्डल;
१३: Br. II. १८. २६-42, ५०-52:
addressed by Agni to bear Rudra's गर्भ, गन्गा accepted the task and gave birth to कुमार.
१४: Br. III. 7. ३५५: 9. 4: १०. ३०-5: १४. ८४: ३७. 5: ५४. ४९: IV. 9. ७८.
गन्गा refilled the ocean, after Agastya drank it dry.
१५: Br. III. ६३. १६७.
Manu put the growing fish in; washed off the city of हस्तिनापुरम्; contains 3(1/2) crores of तीर्थस्; forms the cure for all ills; released in seven streams by शन्कर, three to the west, three to the north and one भगीरथी, sacred in Kanakhala.
१६: M. 1. २३: १३. २५: ३६. 5: ५०. ७८: १०२. 5-6: १०६. ५७-8; ११४. २०: १२१. ३८-41; १३३. २३: १८३. १०७: १८६. १०; १९२. ११; २३९-18.
Wife of the ocean;
१७: वा. १३. ३५: ३०. ३२ and ९२: ४५. ९५:
त्रिपथगा;
१८: वा. 2. 7; ५१. २१, ४६; ५८. ८८.
a consort of शिव, served by Trayambaka and other gods.
१९: वा. ४२. ३९-40: ७१. 5.
Fit for श्राद्ध;
२०: वा. ७७. ६८.
the right side of the Veda;
२१: वा. ९८. ११७: ९९. ६३: १०४. १३, २७, ७७: १०६. ६७: १११. १६.
particularly sacred at three spots--गन्गाद्वार, प्रयाग and गन्गा sa1gara-sangama.
२२: M. १०६. ५३.
[page१-503+ २५]
(II)--(personified) a bearer of flywhisk to ललिता. Br. IV. ३९. ७४. गन्गाद्वार--a place sacred to पितृस्. भा. VI. 2. ३९: M. २२. १०: २४६. ९२.
--a Gandharva. वा. ६९. २६.
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९३. १४-20.
--a son of Upamadga (see gandhamodavaha). (Cal. Edn.). Vi. IV. १४. 9.
--the daughter of पितृस्, born in the परा- शर line and mother of व्यास; again born as Matsyayoni. After her came Acchoda lake. Br. III. १३. ७६-9: वा. ७७. ७४-5.
--said to be essence milked from cow-earth by the Gandharvas. M. 7. १४: १०. २४: १६. २६.
(I)--followed राम in his expedition to लन्का. भा. IX. १०. १९: Br. III. ७१. ११२.
(II)--a son of श्वफल्क and गान्दिनी. भा. IX. २४. १७.
(I)--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २३१.
(II)--a forest on the south of इलावृत. Vi. II. 2. २५. [page१-511+ ४३]

(III)--a mountain range to the East of इलावृत and to the W. of Meru and a boundary limit of Bha- द्राश्व. On its top falls the सीता.
1: भा. V. १६. १०: १७. 6. Vi. II. 2. १८, २९ and ३९:
The abode of Nara and नारायण, visited by ब्रह्मा.
2: भा. IV. 1. ५८: V. 1. 8. Vi. V. २४. 5.
To this Mucukunda (s.v.) repaired after leaving the cave in which he slept.
3: भा. X. ५२. 3.
Location and length mentioned. Residence of वानरस्. Here उर्वशि stayed for some time with Aila. Here विष्णु performed तपस् as Dharmasuta and created उर्वशी.
4: Br. II. १५. ४०: १७. १६: III. 7. १९४: २५. ६७: ६६. 7: IV. ३१. १६: M. ६१. २१: २४. १९.
One of the विष्- kambagiris round Meru. Here are केतुमालवर्ष and वैभाज forest; the crown of जम्बूद्वीप; full of celestial groups.
5: M. ८३. २२, ३२-3: ११३. ४५: १५४. ४३४: १८३. 1.
A place of pilgrimage sacred to कामाक्षी.
6: M. १३. २६.
On its south आनील and निषाधस्, and on its East माल्यवन्.
7: वा. ३४. ३५: ३५. १६: ४२. २५: ४३. 1: ४६. १७: ९१. 7.
The place where the Bhadari आश्रम was situated and to which came Uddhava for penance.
8: Vi. V. ३७. ३४ and ३७.
--the kingdom of केतुमाल. Br. II. १४. ५२: वा 23. १५९: ३३. ४५.
--a division of जम्बूद्वीप. Vi. II. 1. २३.
--a son of Upamadga. Vi. IV. १४. 9.

(II)--a kingdom noted for horses;
1: Br. IV. १६. १७: M. ११४. 8: १२१. ४८.
a divi- sion of the भारतवर्ष.
2: वा. ४५. ७९: Vi. II. 3. 7.
(III)--a god to be worshipped in house- building. M. २५३. २५. [page१-512+ ४५]
(IV)--the fourteenth kalpa; here गान्- धारस्वर and नाद came into being. वा. २१. ३२.
--one of the nine divisions of भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. 9. M. ४८. 7.
(II)--(Mauneya) in number ६० crores, overcame the नागस् of रसातल and deprived them of their jewels, etc.; ultimately defeated by Purukutsa, son of मान्धात. Vi. IV. 3. 4-9.
--an imaginary city compared to this माया-ridden universe; seen by the company of merchants (जीवस्) wandering in सम्सार. भा. IV. १२. १५. V. १३. 3 and 7.
--Bharata in charge of; killed three crores of them. Vi. IV. 4. १००.
--the name om rising from गान्धार. वा. २०. 3.
(I)--a daughter of Surabhi and कश्यप, and a sister of Rudras; mother of horses like उच्चैश्श्रवस्. Br. III. 3. ७३-7.
(II)--a daughter of Gandharvas. वा. ६९. १०. [page१-528+ ३३]
(III)--a R. from the lake विष्णुपदम्. Br. II. १८. ६८; वा. ४७. ६५.
--the सभा of वायु on the sixth slope of Meru. वा. ३४. ८९.
--the quality of the earth eaten up by waters in प्रत्याहार. वा. १०२. 7.
--a pravara of Angiras M. १९६. १७.

--a daughter of काशिराज, married श्वफल्क, mother of अक्रूर and other sons, used to present a cow every day to a ब्राह्मण (born after १२ years in the womb when her parents gave a gift of a cow everyday to a Brah- man-वि। प्। for three years). भा. IX. २४. १५: X. ४१. 6: ४९. 3: ५७. ३२: Br. III. ७१. ८२-110. वा. ९६. ९७, १०५, १०९: Vi. IV. १३. १२४-6; १४. 7.
(I)--a form of marriage by which कृष्ण married रुक्मिणी, and दुष्यन्त married शकुन्तला. Prin- cesses usually chose their husbands. भा. III. 3. 3; IX. २०. १५-16; Br. IV. १५. 5; Vi. III. १०. २४.

(II)--the science of music; a विद्या; मूर्- chanas and their लक्षणस् in;
1: वा. ८६. २६, ३६-69. Vi. III. 6. २८.
the music displayed at the court of ब्रह्मा; also the music played upon by कृष्ण.
2: भा. IX. 3. ३०; X. २१. 5[1]; Br. III. ६१. २१, २६-8.
--attained by पुरूरवस्. Vi. IV. 6. ९३.
--music. भा. III. १२. ३८.
(I)--the son of Aru(d)dha (आरब्ध-भा। प्।, वि। प्।). After him came the गान्धार country famous for horses. Father of Dharma. भा. IX. २३. १५; Br. III. ७४. 9-१०; वा. ९९. 9; Vi. IV. १७. 4.

(II) (स्वर)--an auspicious one;
1: M. २४३. २१.
the third of the seven notes of music.
2: वा. २१-32; ८६. ३७.
--a son of शरद्वत् and a grandson of Druhyu, after whom was named the country गान्धार; had choice horses of the आरट्ट country. M. ४८. 6-7.
--a kind of sweet rice; unfit for श्राद्ध. Vi. III. १६. 8.
--of Agastya family. M. २०२. 2.
--musical term. वा. ८६. ४१, ५०. [page१-529+ ४२]

(I)--the wife of धृतराष्ट्र and mother of hundred sons--Duryodhana and others.
1: भा. IX. २२. २६. M. ५०. ४७-8. वा. ९९. २४२. Vi. IV. २०. ३९.
Daughter of Subala.
2: भा. X. ८४. 1.
Met by कृष्ण and राम after the burning of lac house.
3: Ib. ५७. 2.
Heard of कृष्ण's marriage from his wives and was lost in wonder.
4: Ib. X. ८४. 1.
Her grief at भीष्म's death; was consoled by युधिष्ठिर.
5: Ib. I. 9. ४८.
Felt keenly कृष्ण's separation. Wel- comed Vidura to हस्तिनापुर.
6: Ib. १०. 9; १३. 4.
Approved of the anointing of युधिष्ठिर.
7: Ib. X. ८०[5].
Went with her daughter to स्यमन्तपञ्- caka for solar eclipse, and there met कृष्ण and वृष्णिस्.
8: Ib. ८२. २४.
Settled on the banks of the Ganges with धृतराष्ट्र, follow- ing him to the Himalayas. As a chaste queen she ascended his funeral pyre.
9: Ib. I. 8. 3; १३. २९ and ५७.
(II)--one of the wives of धृष्टि. Father of Sumitra. Br. III. ७१. १८-19.
(V)--a daughter of Surabhi and कश्यप. वा. ६६. ७१.
(III)--the wife of वृष्णि; gave birth to Sumitra. M. ४५. 1: वा. ९६. १७.
(IV)--a queen of कृष्ण. M. ४७. १३.
